results.title: Gothic Slayers
results.overview: Two putt-putt employees and best friends must face off against a demonic cult that has not only kidnapped their friend but also threatens to destroy their hometown.

results.title: Skelter
results.overview: Skelter is a coming of age drama that takes place over a day at a fairground. The film follows Nip as she spends her last day working at the show, leaving a wealth of memories, friends, and rides behind her.

results.title: Okay?
results.overview: A doctor learns to accept the loss of her mother when she helps her non-binary trans patient regain their ability to dance.

results.title: O Esqueleto
results.overview: The film tells us how university vacations changed our protagonist's life. The vacations took him home, as they did every year, but that year he was overcome by the vertigo of passion, culminating in a marriage proposal. Everything turns out to be ephemeral, misleading, where the betrayal of his closest friend may, after all, stem solely from his characteristic recklessness. But the reasons don't matter, what matters are the actions and their interpretation by each of the characters, which lead to the supreme act of love... and revenge.

results.title: Purple
results.overview: After the loss of their mother, Maxine and Xavier's father becomes very distant and neglectful to his family. This causes Maxine to start acting out and serious alarm bells go off when her brother and older sister spot her black eye.

results.title: La Belle au Bois Dormant
results.overview: King Florestan XIV invites all the fairies in the kingdom to the christening of his daughter Aurora. As they bestow beauty, generosity, and grace upon the princess, they are interrupted by the arrival of the horrible fairy Carabosse, who, furious at not having been invited to the festivities, casts a curse on Princess Aurora: on her 16th birthday, she will prick her finger and die. Recorded on April 7 and 10, 2025, at the Opéra Bastille in Paris's 12th arrondissement.

results.title: Ella
results.overview: During a Gershwin recording session, Ella Fitzgerald sings her love songs, scatting through her darkest notes.

results.title: Turba
results.overview: Six Black women throw themselves overboard to escape a slave ship bound for America. Based on Jericó Montilla's play of the same name (a free adaptation of Fabienne Kanor's Humus), directed by brothers Andrés and Luis Rodríguez. Less narrative than sensation: a visceral, poetic journey about resistance and the search for freedom, shot in Choroní and Caracas under CNAC's "Aprender haciendo" training program. Venezuela, 2025/2026.

results.title: Facsimile
results.overview: Two investigators explore a strange cave on a Palouse farmer's property. Their discoveries quickly develop into cosmic horrors.

results.title: Whispers
results.overview: Set after The Whisper (2023) and The Whisper 2: Natural Connection (2024), this full-length movie sequel follows a town plagued by disappearances. Three men embark on a desperate search, leading them toward a chilling truth.

results.title: Juana Pelos
results.overview: A young Latina girl, getting bullied at school for her prominent leg hair, begs her mother to let her shave her legs. When her mom adamantly refuses, the girl turns to her older sister for help.

results.title: A Dickens of a Christmas
results.overview: Zara, a lawyer haunted by Christmas memories, attends a Victorian dinner where she meets Rafe, a renovator. His ghostly ancestor plays matchmaker by giving Zara a book of love stories, challenging her skepticism about romance.

results.title: Snatchers
results.overview: A  pair of life-long friends try to make a quick buck by selling the organs of a fresh corpse but get thrown a curveball when she wakes up on the operating table.

results.title: Latin Blood – The Ballad of Ney Matogrosso
results.overview: From a repressive childhood to artistic revolution, Ney Matogrosso transforms Brazil's stages — and himself — through music, creativity and inner fire.

results.title: Whisper in the Pines
results.overview: A weekend camping trip turns sinister when friends ignore warnings and venture into Pine Hollow Forest, where local legends speak of vanishing hikers. As darkness falls and one friend disappears, they face an ancient evil lurking around.

results.title: Madonna Mia
results.overview: Set in a small catholic town in Italy, 15-year-old Gaia tries to navigate her sexual fantasies while completing her confirmation.

results.title: Lulu
results.overview: Lulu a influencer goes back to his country.

results.title: Terminated Link
results.overview: A matriarch of a grief-stricken family receives a second chance at life with her late husband.
